parameters.content:
## Setup

1. Run `ghl-integration/setup-custom-fields.js` and paste each printed **fieldKey** into **Upsert GHL Contact** if it differs from the defaults (`contact.1m_total_score`, `contact.numbers_score`, `contact.trust_score`, `contact.known_score`, `contact.found_score`, `contact.top_priority`).
2. Replace `{{GHL_TOKEN}}` and `{{GHL_LOCATION_ID}}` in **Upsert GHL Contact**. Preferred: n8n Header Auth credential (`Authorization: Bearer <PRIVATE_INTEGRATION_TOKEN>`) and a hardcoded location ID. Token scopes: `contacts.write`. Custom-field scopes are only needed for the setup script.
3. Connect a Slack credential on **Notify Slack**. Channel: `#sales`.
4. Activate this workflow. Copy the **Production** URL (`/webhook/scorecard-lead`) into `CONFIG.leadWebhookUrl` in `app.js`.
5. Tag applied in GHL: **1M Scorecard**. Upsert overwrites existing tags on a matched contact.

API: `POST https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/contacts/upsert`
Headers: `Authorization: Bearer …`, `Version: 2021-07-28`

## Credentials placeholders

In **Upsert GHL Contact**:
- Header `Authorization`: `Bearer {{GHL_TOKEN}}`
- Body `locationId`: `{{GHL_LOCATION_ID}}`

Replace those two placeholders before activating. Do not leave the mustache values — n8n will try to evaluate them as expressions.

**Notify Slack** uses a placeholder Slack credential. Open the node and select a real Slack account.

  ]
} }}
